severities.label: Critical / Safety Hazards
severities.guidance: Anything unsafe or actively failing: exposed or double-tapped wiring, gas leaks, no GFCI near water, structural movement, failed heat, active water intrusion, missing smoke alarms.

severities.label: Major Systems & Capital Expenses
severities.guidance: Big-ticket items with a real dollar cost and a service life: roof, HVAC, water heater, sewer line, foundation drainage, windows, major appliances at end of life.

severities.label: Cosmetic / Minor Maintenance
severities.guidance: Wear, appearance, and small handyman items: scuffed paint, sticking doors, loose handles, worn caulk, dirty filters, minor landscaping.

resolutions.label: Seller to repair before closing
resolutions.phrasing: Seller to repair prior to closing, by a licensed contractor, with receipts provided at final walkthrough.

resolutions.label: Seller credit at closing
resolutions.phrasing: Seller to issue a closing credit of {amount} in lieu of repair.

resolutions.label: Price reduction
resolutions.phrasing: Purchase price to be reduced by {amount}.

resolutions.label: Noted, no action requested
resolutions.phrasing: Noted for the buyer's awareness. No action requested.
